summary: Defines the structure and retrieval logic for cost centre records associated with placements.
purpose: Allows for the retrieval and handling of financial data related to placements and associated costs.

fields.name: Program
fields.description: Program under which the placement falls.

fields.name: Discipline
fields.description: Specific field or discipline associated with the placement.

fields.name: CostCentreDescription
fields.description: Description of the cost center's function.

fields.name: ProgramYear
fields.description: Academic year related to the program.

fields.name: ReferenceNumber
fields.description: Unique reference number for the placement.

fields.name: CFO
fields.description: Chief Financial Officer responsible for the costs.

fields.name: StudentCount
fields.description: Number of students in the placement.

fields.name: PRHours
fields.description: Total hours associated with the placement requests.

steps.step: Invoke database procedure for placement cost center.
Process and return cost center records.
